## About
Genard's Auto Repair is on S. Cooper St. in Arlington, off Colorado Lane, across from Krispy Kreme and behind Metro Champion Auto Repair. If you have car trouble, that's where you'll find us.
We work on all things related to your auto repair needs: brakes, tune-ups, suspensions, A/C, engines, transmissions, clutches and electronic diagnostics. We believe diagnostics matter, so we find the real problem before we fix it, and we care about getting your car back to you on time.
Customers who leave reviews tend to talk about honest work and fair prices. A reviewer mentioned that Genard's son works in the shop with him, with the same pride in the work. If you'd like to hear from other customers, we can share referrals on request.

## Services
- Brake services: Brake work to keep your stops safe and quiet.
- Performance tune-ups: Tune-ups to keep your engine running the way it should.
- Suspension repairs: Repairs for the parts that keep your ride smooth and steady.
- A/C services and repairs: Service and repair for your car's air conditioning.
- Engine repair: Engine repair work, big or small.
- Transmission services: Transmission work. A reviewer brought in an Infiniti for transmission repairs and called the work outstanding.
- Clutch repair: Clutch service and repair for manual transmissions.
- Electronic diagnostics: Electronic diagnostics to track down what's actually wrong before any work starts.

## FAQ
Q: How do I find the shop?
A: We're on S. Cooper St. off Colorado Lane, across from Krispy Kreme and behind Metro Champion Auto Repair.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday hours are 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM. The shop is closed Sunday.

Q: Can I talk to other customers before I bring my car in?
A: Yes. Just ask, and we can put you in touch with satisfied customers.
